miniz 3.1.0, commit 174573d60290f447c13a2b1b3405de2b96e27d6c
https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/tree/3.1.0

Upstream sources are unmodified. miniz_export.h supplies the static-build
export macro normally generated by upstream CMake. LICENSE is included.
RomM builds only the ZIP reader and inflater, with archive writing and
zlib-style APIs disabled. ZIP/ZIP64 stored and DEFLATE entries are supported.
